_whatItIs: Temperature readings in, one per sensor per second, 1,000 sensors across 100 locations. Out: one row per location per one-hour bucket carrying the TOTAL and the COUNT, so nobody has to argue about a rounded average. The bucket comes from the timestamp inside the reading; the machine clock is never used. ANSWERS.md is the spec, ASSUMPTIONS.md holds every decision the answers did not settle.
_secondVantage: The outputs are PER WINDOW -- one row per location per hour, however many readings arrived -- so there is no constant fan-out anywhere in the job and outputsPerInput would be a property of the test data rather than of the pipeline. The second reading is therefore a command: st44.Progress sums the count field the pipeline already publishes, which is exactly how much input its own output accounts for. It moves one closed hour at a time, and ASSUMPTIONS.md B4 staggers the 100 locations so that step is 36,000 readings and not 3,600,000.
_topicsOut: Empty, and allowed to be empty only because secondVantage is a command. The hourly rows are declared in topicsAlsoWritten instead, which is what makes the completeness drain refuse a build that never writes them.
_backlogs: GUESSES, written before anything was measured, as section 3 says they must be. They are re-derived from the rate the tiny proof measures and the numbers in this file at the end of the run are the measured ones.
_dashboard: Built by the harness from this file (scalable-flink-skill harness/board.py): input, input lag, output, checkpoints, broker, Flink, and the Redis store when run-reference.sh is given STORE=redis. Run 44 built its own; that is what the harness now does for every run.

guarantee.sink: at-least-once, idempotent (the absolute total and count per location and hour)

_reference: A known-good pipeline, kept so a harness change can be measured without an agent building a new one first. It is clean-room run 44's build, whose ten cases all measured and whose completeness passed both arms with no tolerances. {RUNDIR} is replaced by run-reference.sh with wherever the fixture was copied to. DO NOT let a clean-room agent read this directory: it is a worked answer to the interview they are meant to answer themselves.
